task: Compare the Montana State Library (MSL) Transportation Framework roads with Census TIGER/Line roads for the Billings tile (45.75-45.85 N, 108.55-108.45 W) and the Benchland tile (47.05-47.15 N, 110.05-109.95 W); currency; legal basis; recommendation.
bottom_line: Publish from TIGER/Line 2026, not from the state file, unless Montana State Library grants written permission. TIGER's use terms are explicit (not copyrighted, free to use, Census Bureau acknowledgement required). The state file (258,208 segments, exported 2026-09-30) has richer attributes and address ranges, but its metadata gives a disclaimer and no licence. Geometry agrees closely in both tiles (93.9 to 98.8 percent of each source's length lies within 15 m of the other), so the choice turns on legal clarity and cleaning, not on geometry.
recommendation: 1) Base layer: TIGER/Line 2026 county road files (roads layer, with FULLNAME, MTFCC and RTTYP) plus the TIGER 2026 ADDR address-range files for the address search (ADDR has no street names; names come from the EDGES file keyed by TLID, not tested here). All 56 Montana county road zips total 88,859,641 bytes (HEAD sizes). Credit the U.S. Census Bureau on the About page; avoid TIGER/Line or Census TIGER in product names (prudent inference from the trademark sentence, not a stated rule); carry the Census accuracy caveat (not for property transfers or engineering). 2) Clean before drawing or counting: merge or drop concurrent and doubled TIGER features (Benchland: 74.9 percent of in-tile length shares geometry with another TIGER feature; Billings: 18.8 percent), normalise names to one spelling (TIGER abbreviates, MSL spells out), and treat blank names (11.0 percent in Billings, 27.0 percent in Benchland, 25.6 percent county-wide) and placeholder names such as 'Internal' as unnamed. 3) Only if MSL confirms in writing that derived tiles may be redistributed: enrich TIGER lines with MSL name parts, RoadClass, SurfaceType, Ownership and FromAddr/ToAddr ranges by a within-15 m match, and publish the match rate per tile. Until then, MSL is an internal comparison reference only, and that use should be confirmed with MSL too.
method: Downloaded and read the MSL shapefile zip by HTTP range requests (server returned 206): central directory, metadata XML, readme, DBF header (record count and fields).

Statewide road layer: the shapefile zip's roads members total 117,624,719 bytes compressed (over the 100 MB rule), so it was not downloaded. The geodatabase zip (81,190,547 bytes, under 100 MB) was downloaded in full, zip-tested and read with pyogrio 0.13.0 (bundled GDAL 3.12.4, OpenFileGDB driver) in a venv under the scratch folder.

TIGER: downloaded tl_2026_30111_roads.zip (newest; the prompt named TIGER2025 first, and TIGER2026 exists), tl_2025_30111_roads.zip for the currency comparison, tl_2026_30045_roads.zip for the Benchland tile (MSL County_L for all 73 Benchland segments is Judith Basin County, not Fergus County), and tl_2026_30111_addr.zip for the address-file check.

Tile test: a feature counts when any part intersects the tile box in lon/lat; length is the geodesic length (GRS80) of the in-box portion, Liang-Barsky clipped; MSL projected NAD83(2011) Montana (EPSG:6514, metres) is transformed to NAD83 lon/lat (EPSG:4269) with pyproj.

Names: upper-case, directional and type words mapped to USPS-style abbreviations, ordinals to numerals, route phrases ('United States Highway' to 'US HWY'), punctuation removed; matched on a compact key (spaces and hyphens removed). Placeholder names (Dwy, Driveway, Unknown, No Name, Unnamed, Internal is NOT treated as placeholder) excluded from name sets.

Geometry agreement: in-tile segments sampled every 5 m; each sample is within 15 m (or 30 m) of a sample of the other source, length-weighted. Internal overlap: share of in-tile length within 3 m of a different feature in the same source.
Sample points checked: 401 North 27th Street (45.7836 N, 108.5047 W) and a rural point near Benchland (47.08 N, 110.02 W), nearest segments in both sources.

Not done: no address-to-segment geocoding test (TIGER ADDR cannot be joined to the roads layer without the EDGES file, which was not downloaded to stay under the budget), no statewide county-by-county comparison, no check of the MSL REST map service.
decisions: Newest TIGER release used as primary (TIGER2026, dated 2026-10-06); TIGER2025 kept as the comparison.
Statewide MSL roads: geodatabase zip (81.2 MB) chosen over the shapefile zip (117.6 MB) to stay under the 100 MB rule.
Benchland tile TIGER county: Judith Basin (30045), per MSL County_L; Fergus was an assumption that the data did not support.

Shared venv (/home/user/hail-b1/venv) has no FileGDB reader; a separate venv under the scratch folder was created with pyogrio 0.13.0 (PyPI). Installed size 220 MB; the pip cache at /root/.cache/pip is shared, so the PyPI network bytes were not isolated and are excluded from download_bytes_total.

open_questions: Written permission from Montana State Library (geoinfo@mt.gov, 406-444-5354 per the readme) on whether derived tiles of the Transportation Framework may be published, and whether attribution is required. Unverified; this decides whether MSL can be shipped.
What 'for no other purpose' in the MSL use constraint means for redistribution (ambiguous wording; not resolved here).
MSL export cadence: monthly (readme) against 'As needed' (FGDC) against 'regularly updated' (web page); only six archived exports (2012 to 2017) are in the folder, so the monthly claim is unverified.
TIGER ADDR to roads join: the roads layer has no TLID; the address file needs EDGES (TLID to FULLNAME, LINEARID) to link. Not downloaded here, so a TIGER address-search test is still open.

Whether MSL address ranges and TIGER address ranges agree on the 400 block of North 27th Street; the owner's coordinate is 258.6 m from the MSL 400-block segment, so an address point source is needed to test.
Dedupe rule for TIGER concurrent routes (US 87, MT 3, MT 200 share geometry) and doubled county roads: keep one line with all names, or keep all and dedupe at draw time? Not decided.
Route naming: MSL 'Highway 87 North' and TIGER 'US Hwy 87' do not normalise to one name; route-name mapping is needed for the search.
Placeholder policy for MSL 'Driveway', 'Dwy', 'Unknown' (22,662 statewide, concentrated outside Yellowstone County) and TIGER 'Internal': exclude from street names?

Whether the county-level TIGER total (4,345 mi) overstates unique road length: 18.8 percent (Billings) to 74.9 percent (Benchland) of in-tile length overlaps another TIGER feature; a union length was not computed.
Only two tiles compared (Billings, Benchland). Statewide agreement, class mapping and the 56-county TIGER set were not tested for content; the 56 county sizes are HEAD values only.
